title: Roof Repair in McAllen, TX | Edel Roofing & Construction
description: Roof leak and wind damage repair in McAllen, TX. Written estimate before any work, most repairs done in one visit. Licensed RCAT #03-0489. Call (956) 422-3335.
lede: Edel Roofing & Construction fixes leaks, wind lifted shingles, and worn flashing on McAllen homes. Our office is about 6 miles from McAllen City Hall, and most repairs are done in one visit.

sections.title: Roof repair for McAllen homes
paras: McAllen has a lot of roofs that are old enough to need work. Census survey data (ACS 2024) puts the median McAllen home at 1997, and about 4 in 10 homes were built before 1990. On a roof that has been through 20 or 30 Valley summers, leaks tend to start at the openings and edges: flashing along a wall, a pipe boot cracked by the sun, shingles that let go along a ridge or a rake edge.

A leak does not mean you need a new roof. Most leaks come from one spot, and one spot can be fixed. If a repair is enough, that is what we quote. If the roof is past repairing, we show you the photos and explain why before replacement comes up at all.
Our office is at 1815 N Jackson Rd in Edinburg, about 11 minutes by car from McAllen City Hall. That short drive is why we can usually get to a McAllen leak quickly.

sections.title: What recent storms did to McAllen roofs
paras: The National Weather Service has logged several damaging wind events in McAllen in the last few years. On April 28, 2023, a 74 mph gust was measured in the city, and an NWS damage survey found a building on S 29th St that had lost more than half of its shingles. On May 8, 2025, a microburst with winds estimated at 80 to 85 mph came down between Taylor Rd and Ware Rd. The NWS survey counted several dozen damaged homes, at least three with shingles partly lifted.
Hail adds to the wear. Spotters reported hail up to 1.25 inches in McAllen on April 21, 2023, and up to 2 inches in north McAllen during the May 2025 storm.

Partly lifted shingles are easy to miss. The shingle drops back down after the wind passes, but the seal strip that held it is broken. The next strong wind can tear it off, and rain can blow in under it before that. If your street was hit in one of these storms and nobody has been on the roof since, it is worth an inspection. For bigger storm claims, see storm and hail damage in McAllen.

sections.title: Repairs we do on McAllen roofs

cards.title: Leaks
cards.body: We find where the water gets in, which is often several feet uphill from the stain on your ceiling, and fix it at that spot.

cards.title: Wind lifted shingles
cards.body: Shingles that lost their seal in a storm get resealed or replaced, matched as close as we can to the rest of the roof.

cards.title: Flashing
cards.body: Flashing at walls, chimneys, and valleys is where many leaks start. We reseal it or replace the failed piece.

cards.title: Pipe boots and vents
cards.body: The rubber collar around a plumbing vent cracks after years of sun. A new boot is a small job that stops a common leak.

cards.title: Hail hits
cards.body: Cracked or bruised shingles are replaced in the damaged area, and we write down what we found for your records.

cards.title: Skylights
cards.body: A failed skylight seal gets resealed or reflashed without tearing into the rest of the roof.

sections.title: How a McAllen repair visit works

cards.title: 1. Call or book
cards.body: Call (956) 422-3335 or book online. Tell us what you are seeing: a stain, a drip, shingles in the yard.

cards.title: 2. Inspection
cards.body: We go up on the roof, find the source of the problem, and take photos you can keep.

cards.title: 3. Written price
cards.body: You get the estimate in writing before any work starts, so you know the number before you agree to anything.

cards.title: 4. Repair
cards.body: Most repairs are finished in one visit once we know what failed.

faqs.q: The wind lifted some shingles but nothing is leaking. Should I wait?
faqs.a: We would not wait long. A shingle that lost its seal can come off in the next storm, and water can get under it before you ever see a stain. A free inspection tells you whether it is a few shingles or a bigger area.

faqs.q: How much does roof repair cost in McAllen?
faqs.a: Most repairs run from a few hundred dollars up to around $1,500. The price depends on what failed and how much of the roof it touches. You get a written estimate after the inspection and before any work.

faqs.q: Do I need a permit for a roof repair in McAllen?
faqs.a: McAllen builds to the 2024 International Residential Code, and the city's residential permit application covers roofing work. For your specific job, McAllen Permits and Inspections can answer at (956) 681-1300.

faqs.q: Can you waive my insurance deductible?
faqs.a: No. The Texas Department of Insurance says it is illegal for a contractor to waive or rebate your deductible. Be careful with anyone who offers to.

faqs.q: Will my insurance pay for the repair?
faqs.a: It depends on the cause. Damage from a specific storm is often covered, and normal wear from age usually is not. We put what we find in writing with photos so you can show your insurer. We are not a public adjuster, so the claim decision is between you and your insurance company.

faqs.q: How do I book a repair estimate in McAllen?
faqs.a: Call (956) 422-3335 or book an inspection online. The inspection and estimate are free, with no obligation.
